The unpadded IDs fall in the same 1-200 numeric range as the customer dimension, so normalizing the format in silver_transactions restores the join.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(trim(customer_id), '^[Cc][0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(CAST(CAST(substr(trim(customer_id), 2) AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
